anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.text:
Which behavior should the report view apply to active filters when the user switches workspaces?

A) clear all filters on every workspace switch
B) preserve all active filters across switches
C) restore each workspace's last filters

Recommendation: C - filters usually belong to the workspace where they were set, so restoring them avoids carrying one workspace's filters into another without wiping the user's work. The cost is per-workspace saved state; if that state is unwanted, B matches today's handler at ui/report-view.ts:30.
